Container.Name: architecturer
Container.Overview: Architecturer: AI-first 3D architecture modeler as a remote MCP server. AI apps (Claude web/desktop/mobile, ChatGPT, LM Studio, Claude Code) design buildings from JSON plans, render them and export textured GLB models. Includes OAuth login, personal tokens, a live 3D viewer per project and download links.[br][br] Put it behind a Cloudflare Tunnel: public hostname -> http://[UNRAID-IP]:5178, and a Cloudflare Access application covering only the paths /authorize, /admin, /view and /login. Leave /mcp, /.well-known, /register, /token, /revoke and /files unchallenged so Claude and ChatGPT can reach them. Full guide: docs/REMOTE_MCP.md in the project.[br][br] Memory: a big furnished plan can need ~3.5 GB per render worker while exporting (the template limits the container to 4 GB with 1 worker). No GPU needed.[br][br] Data: if appdata is not an exclusive (pool-only) share, map /data to a pool path such as /mnt/cache/appdata/architecturer so the viewer's live reload sees file changes.
Container.Requires: A Cloudflare Tunnel (or another HTTPS reverse proxy) with a public hostname, and Cloudflare Access or an admin password for login.

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: HTTP port (MCP endpoint /mcp, admin page /admin, viewer /view). Point the Cloudflare Tunnel's public hostname here.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Projects (plans/, exports in plans/exports), auth state (state/: keep private, back it up) and the asset download cache (cache/).

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Public https origin clients reach (your tunnel hostname), with no path. OAuth and every link use it.

Config.Name: Cloudflare Access team domain
Config.Description: Login through Cloudflare Access: your team domain, e.g. myteam.cloudflareaccess.com. Set together with the AUD tag.

Config.Name: Cloudflare Access AUD tag
Config.Description: The Access application's Application Audience (AUD) tag.

Config.Name: Allowed emails
Config.Description: Comma-separated emails allowed to log in through Access and approve apps. Empty = whoever your Access policy admits.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Login with a password instead of (or as well as) Cloudflare Access. Long and random. With neither set, OAuth is off and only personal tokens work.

Config.Name: Render workers
Config.Description: Parallel render/export workers. Each can need ~3.5 GB on big plans: raise --memory in Extra Parameters with it (2 workers: --memory=8g).

Config.Name: Allow private network fetches
Config.Description: Set to 1 to let plans load models / textures from LAN addresses (a NAS). Off by default.

Config.Name: Extra allowed hosts
Config.Description: Comma-separated extra host names accepted (e.g. tower.local). The public host, localhost and IP addresses are always accepted.

Config.Name: Viewer texture size
Config.Description: Texture resolution of the model the live viewer loads.
